event.title: fix: bump qs minimum to ^6.14.2 for CVE-2026-2391
event.body:
## Summary

Bumps the `qs` dependency minimum from `^6.14.1` to `^6.14.2` to address [CVE-2026-2391](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-2391) / [GHSA-w7fw-mjwx-w883](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-w7fw-mjwx-w883).

**Vulnerability:** qs versions before 6.14.2 have an `arrayLimit` bypass in comma parsing that allows denial of service.

While the existing `^6.14.1` semver range already resolves to 6.14.2+ on fresh installs, bumping the minimum ensures:
- The vulnerable version cannot be pinned or resolved via lockfiles
- `npm audit` no longer flags express installations

## Changes

- `package.json`: `"qs": "^6.14.1"` → `"qs": "^6.14.2"` (1 line)

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run lint` passes
- [x] `npm test` passes (1,244 tests)
- [x] `qs@6.15.0` resolved and installed successfully (compatible with ^6.14.2)
